title: Event envelope v1 (CloudEvents-compatible)
description: An event emitted by a site component. Identity (tenant/site) is derived from the site mTLS certificate, not from this payload. CloudEvents fields are used as-is; aiops-specific fields live under `data`. The `data.payload` object is intentionally type-specific and is validated by the producer/consumer for its event type.

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. Only 1.0 is accepted.

id.description: Unique event id within a site. Together with the authenticated site id it forms the idempotency key.

source.description: URN of the emitting site component, e.g. urn:aiops:site:<site-id>:ml-detector. The site id is checked against the mTLS certificate.

type.description: Event type. The v1 suffix is part of the contract; a new shape requires a new type suffix.

subject.description: Human-readable subject, e.g. node/<uid> or deployment/<namespace>/<name>.

time.description: Time the event occurred, UTC RFC 3339. Central assigns received_at/processed_at separately; do not overload this field.

datacontenttype.description: Optional CloudEvents content type; when present it must be application/json.

dataschema.description: Optional URI of the type-specific payload schema.

observed_at.description: Time the signal was observed by the site component, UTC RFC 3339.

entity.description: The entity this event is about, at the lowest meaningful level of the tenant -> site -> cluster -> node -> namespace/workload/pod/container hierarchy.

kind.description: Entity kind. Keep it consistent with the identity hierarchy in SPEC section 4.

id.description: Internal UUID or Kubernetes UID. Kubernetes UIDs are stored alongside internal ids, never instead of them.

payload.description: Type-specific event body. Open by design; each producer/consumer validates the fields it needs. Never place secrets or credentials here.
